<section class="mod_article grid-center block" id="article-1364">
<div class="grid">
<h1 class="ce_headline col-12">Beachfront Vacation Rentals on the Baltic Sea</h1>
<h2 class="ce_headline col-12">Vacation in a thatched-roof house near the beach on Fehmarn</h2>
<div class="ce_text col-12_lg-10 block">
<p>The perfect choice for beach lovers: Book a vacation rental in our idyllic thatched-roof house, just 10 meters from the Baltic Sea beach. Whether you choose the ground-floor or upper-floor vacation apartments, each can accommodate 2 or 4 people, respectively, and there&rsquo;s a shared terrace in front of the house with patio furniture and a beach chair. Parking is available right next to the vacation apartment.</p>
<p>And you&rsquo;ll always enjoy the wide range of recreational, dining, and entertainment options at the Wulfener Hals camping and vacation park: from the pool, sauna, activities, and wellness offerings to breakfast service, half-board, or full-board. Perfect for family vacations, active getaways by the sea, or a romantic retreat on the Baltic Sea.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
